compliance.description: Compliance report generated from the organisation's records, sealed with the platform's audit export key

verification.instruction: The seal is an HMAC-SHA256 under an audit export key the platform holds; manifest.signingKeyId names the key, and manifest.dataHash is the SHA-256 of data. To verify a saved file, a signed-in member of the organisation sends { data, manifest, signature } to POST /api/audit/export/verify. For a CSV, data is the CSV text exactly as saved, and manifest and signature come from the .manifest.json saved with it. An inspector verifies through the organisation.
